endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0616
endorsements.description: The Amelia WordPress plugin before 1.0.47 does not have CSRF check in place when deleting customers, which could allow attackers to make a logged in admin delete arbitrary customers via a CSRF attack
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

endorsements.name: Muhamad Hidayat
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-0634
endorsements.description: The ThirstyAffiliates WordPress plugin before 3.10.5 lacks authorization checks in the ta_insert_external_image action, allowing a low-privilege user (with a role as low as Subscriber) to add an image from an external URL to an affiliate link. Further the plugin lacks csrf checks, allowing an attacker to trick a logged in user to perform the action by crafting a special request.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.
